title: Wave 1 — Scaffold and pure-logic modules
description:
Build the foundation and all pure modules of the TeslaGPUFanControl daemon per docs/PLAN.md (Phase 1 + Phase 3) and the ADRs.

Scope (FILE OWNERSHIP):
- Cargo.toml (deps per PLAN.md §Build), rust-toolchain.toml (channel 1.85, target x86_64-unknown-linux-musl, components rustfmt+clippy)
- src/units.rs — newtypes Celsius(i16), Pct(u8), Pwm(u8); From<Pct> for Pwm; Pct::clamp
- src/curve.rs — Curve type, evaluate() linear interpolation (clamp at edges), construction validation (2..=10 points, monotonic non-decreasing pct)
- src/group.rs — CoolingGroup::target_pct = max over GPUs of clamp(curve(temp), gpu.min, gpu.max); clamp-per-GPU BEFORE max
- src/watchdog.rs — FaultTracker only (pure portion). HardwareWatchdog left as a stub for Wave 2.
- src/config.rs — INI parsing (decide rust-ini vs hand-rolled at start) + ALL S/G/F/W/T validation rules from PLAN.md §Configuration Validation
- src/logger.rs — tracing-subscriber + journald layer + optional file layer; release_max_level_info pinned via Cargo features
- src/main.rs — minimal scaffold so cargo build compiles (full daemon goes in Wave 3)
- src/nvml.rs, src/chip.rs, src/fan.rs — empty/stub modules so the crate compiles. Real impl in Wave 2.

Workflow (per PLAN.md §Testing):
- STRICT TDD on units.rs, curve.rs, group.rs, watchdog::FaultTracker, config::validation. One #[test] per validation rule (S1..T2). Red-green-refactor.
- Test-after on logger.rs.
- All pure modules use #[cfg(test)] mod tests.

Constraints:
- ADR-0006: pure modules never import from I/O modules. Keep dependency direction one-way.
- ADR-0007: panic = abort in release profile. clippy::unwrap_used = deny outside tests. clippy::expect_used = warn (only allowed in main.rs init with invariant-naming messages). thiserror at module level; anyhow only in main.
- No async, no threads, no tokio.
- The exact dep list and lints in Cargo.toml come from PLAN.md §Build verbatim.

Acceptance:
- `cargo build` clean (incl. release profile)
- `cargo fmt --check` clean
- `cargo clippy -- -D warnings` clean
- `cargo test` green; every validation rule has at least one test; FaultTracker has branch coverage on every fault path described in PLAN.md

title: Wave 2 — Core I/O modules (nvml, chip, fan, HardwareWatchdog)
description:
Implement the I/O side of the daemon per docs/PLAN.md (Phase 2) and ADRs 0003/0006.

Scope (FILE OWNERSHIP):
- src/nvml.rs — TempReader trait + NvmlReader (production, wraps nvml-wrapper) + FakeNvml in tests. read_temp applies sanity bounds [5,110]°C; out-of-bounds returns NvmlError::OutOfBounds (counted as a read failure).
- src/chip.rs — scan() (default /sys/class/hwmon) + scan_at(path) for tests; build map chip_name → hwmonN_path; resolve [fan:*] config blocks; refuse to start on miss.
- src/fan.rs — Fan struct (resolved hwmon path, pwm_channel, RPM bounds, fds for pwmN and fanN_input). API: take_manual_control() (snapshot pwm_enable then write 1), set(Pct), set_max(), read_rpm(), check_health() (pure FanHealth state machine), restore() (write back snapshot). Spin-up state machine: enter on take_manual_control() OR when set() raises duty by > 20pp (SPIN_UP_DELTA_PCT const); exit when RPM > min_rpm for one poll OR after spin_up_grace_s elapsed.
- src/watchdog.rs — implement HardwareWatchdog (the ioctl portion). open(device, timeout_s) does WDIOC_SETTIMEOUT; feed() = single byte write; disarm_and_close() writes magic 'V' then closes. unsafe is allowed only here per ADR-0007. If [watchdog].enabled=false, type still exists with no-op methods.

Workflow (per PLAN.md §Testing):
- fan.rs, chip.rs: spike-then-test against tempfile fake sysfs trees. Use scan_at(path) form so tests pass tempdir.
- nvml.rs: test-after via FakeNvml (this is the only trait introduced for testability per ADR-0006).
- HardwareWatchdog: integration test against /dev/watchdog with #[ignore] attribute (requires modprobe softdog; runs locally pre-release, not in CI).
- check_health() is pure — strict-test it (FanHealth: Ok/SpinUp/Stalled/Overspeed; SpinUp must NOT increment fault counter).

Constraints:
- ADR-0003: HardwareWatchdog is independent of fan I/O — main.rs (Wave 3) will own the init order.
- ADR-0006: I/O modules expose intention-revealing APIs (Fan::take_manual_control() etc.), not generic abstractions. Don't introduce traits beyond TempReader.
- ADR-0001: any read failure must propagate as Result, never silently swallowed.

Acceptance:
- All four modules compile and pass cargo test (excluding #[ignore]).
- cargo clippy -- -D warnings clean.
- Tempfile-backed tests cover: chip resolution miss/hit, fan take_manual_control snapshot+restore round-trip, fan set() roundtrip to sysfs, fan health state machine for every variant.
- FakeNvml exercises bounds-violation path.

title: Wave 3 — Daemon composition root (main.rs, signal handlers, calibrate-fans)
description:
Wire all modules into the daemon per docs/PLAN.md (Phase 4) and ADRs 0001/0003/0007.

Scope (FILE OWNERSHIP):
- src/main.rs — single-threaded, blocking, no async (ADR-0007). clap-derive CLI: -c <config>, -f (foreground), --version, --check-config, --calibrate-fans. Init order EXACTLY per ADR-0003: parse+validate config → resolve chips → NVML init → open watchdog + WDIOC_SETTIMEOUT → take_manual_control on every fan → sd_notify(READY=1) → main loop. Main loop per PLAN.md §main.rs (read temps → tick_gpu → group target_pct → fan.set + read_rpm + tick_fan → if !any_fault: feed watchdog + sd_notify("WATCHDOG=1") → sleep poll_interval_ms). Signal handlers via signal-hook AtomicBool: SIGTERM/SIGINT graceful shutdown, SIGHUP reload (data-only swap with structural diff rejection), SIGUSR1 dump state. Graceful shutdown: stop loop → Fan::restore() each fan → HardwareWatchdog::disarm_and_close() → nvmlShutdown → exit 0.
- sd_notify: write directly to $NOTIFY_SOCKET (~20 LOC, no extra crate).
- --calibrate-fans subcommand per PLAN.md §Calibration: refuse if service active, take manual control (no watchdog), sweep PWM 10→60% in 5% steps with 4s settles, print recommendations, restore snapshots, exit 0.
- tests/smoke.rs — runs the built binary with --check-config against config/tesla_fan_control.conf (asserts exit 0) and against per-rule failure fixtures (S4, G2, F1, etc.; asserts exit 1 and rule code in stderr).

Workflow:
- main.rs: no TDD (composition root). Smoke tests written last per PLAN.md.
- Lints: clippy::expect_used permitted in main.rs init only, with messages naming the invariant ("/dev/watchdog open — see ADR-0001 for why this is fatal").

Constraints:
- ADR-0003 startup/shutdown order is load-bearing for safety; do not deviate.
- ADR-0007: no .unwrap() outside tests; no tokio/threads/channels.
- ADR-0001: any fault path must converge on "stop feeding the watchdog".

Acceptance:
- cargo build --release --target x86_64-unknown-linux-musl produces a single static binary.
- `cargo test --test smoke` green: --check-config passes on the canonical config and fails with the right rule code on each fixture.
- Manual smoke (in commit message or PR): foreground run with [watchdog].enabled=false reports temps and writes PWM values to a tempfile-fake hwmon tree.

title: Wave 4 — Polish (install scripts, systemd unit, CI, docs)
description:
Ship the deployment surface per docs/PLAN.md (Phase 5) and ADR-0005.

Scope (FILE OWNERSHIP):
- config/tesla_fan_control.conf — canonical example config, verbatim from PLAN.md §Configuration File Format (3 GPUs, 2 fans, 2 cooling groups). config_version=1.
- systemd/tesla_fan_control.service — verbatim from PLAN.md §systemd Service File. Type=notify, WatchdogSec=30s, LogRateLimit{IntervalSec,Burst}=0, sandboxing block (ProtectSystem=strict, ProtectHome=true, PrivateTmp=true, NoNewPrivileges=true, ProtectKernelLogs=true, ProtectControlGroups=true, RestrictAddressFamilies=AF_UNIX AF_NETLINK, ReadWritePaths=/sys/class/hwmon /dev /run).
- install.sh — install binary to /usr/local/sbin, default config to /etc/tesla_fan_control.conf (skip if exists), unit to /etc/systemd/system/, daemon-reload. CHECKS per PLAN.md §Deployment prerequisites: refuse install if RuntimeWatchdogSec= is set (would conflict for /dev/watchdog) or lsof reports a holder; warn if /sys/module/<wdt>/parameters/nowayout = 1.
- uninstall.sh — stop+disable service, remove binary + unit, leave /etc/tesla_fan_control.conf in place by default; print "reboot recommended to resync BIOS PWM init" per PLAN.md §Fan restore policy.
- README.md — quickstart, prerequisites, calibration workflow (run --calibrate-fans first), config reference (link to PLAN.md), rebuild/install/uninstall commands.
- CHANGELOG.md — Keep-a-Changelog format; v0.1.0 stub with Added section.
- LICENSE — Apache-2.0 (verbatim text) per ADR-0005.
- .github/workflows/ci.yml — fmt --check, clippy -D warnings, test, release musl build. NO #[ignore] tests in CI (softdog not available on GH runners).
- .github/workflows/release.yml — on tag push v*: musl build, sha256 checksum, GH Release with binary + checksum. No cargo publish.

Workflow:
- No TDD for shell/yaml/markdown; verify by running install.sh on a fresh dir into a tempdir prefix and confirming files end up where expected (use a $PREFIX env var to make it testable).

Constraints:
- ADR-0005: license is Apache-2.0; use the canonical text.
- The systemd unit's content must match PLAN.md exactly — operators copy-paste these.

Acceptance:
- ci.yml workflow file lints (`actionlint` if available, otherwise grep for required steps).
- install.sh -n / shellcheck clean.
- README documents: prerequisites, --calibrate-fans flow, --check-config flow, install steps, uninstall steps, /dev/watchdog conflicts, BIOS prerequisite.
